title: 心臟內科
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋胸痛分流與急性冠心症、心導管與介入、心臟衰竭、心律不整與裝置、影像與功能檢查、結構性心臟病、預防心臟學、復健與交班的完整工作流程。
introEn: This library covers chest-pain triage and acute coronary syndromes, catheterisation and intervention, heart failure, arrhythmia and devices, imaging and functional testing, structural heart disease, preventive cardiology, rehabilitation and handover as real workflows.

procedures.title: 急診胸痛分流與 HEART 評估
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲男性，高血壓與抽菸，胸悶 40 分鐘走入急診，冒冷汗。本單元教導分流順序與決策，不取代現場主治判斷。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 58-year-old man, hypertension and smoker, 40 minutes of chest tightness, walks into the ED sweating. Teaches triage order and decisions; it does not replace bedside senior judgement.

stages.title: 檢傷辨識疑似心因性胸痛
stages.titleEn: Recognise possible cardiac chest pain at triage
stages.evidence: 主訴胸口壓迫感、冒冷汗、向左臂放射；檢傷等級尚未決定。
stages.evidenceEn: Pressure-like chest pain with sweating radiating to the left arm; triage level not yet assigned.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 列為第二級以上並立即安排心電圖
choices.en: Triage level 2+ with an immediate ECG

choices.zh: 先抽血驗心肌酶，等報告再分級
choices.en: Draw troponin and triage after results

choices.zh: 生命徵象尚穩定，安排至一般候診區
choices.en: Vitals are stable; general waiting area

stages.reason: 疑似 ACS 的胸痛應在到院 10 分鐘內完成並判讀 12 導程心電圖，分流等級要能啟動此時限。
stages.reasonEn: Suspected ACS needs a 12-lead ECG done and read within 10 minutes of arrival; the triage level must trigger that clock.
stages.pitfall: 若放到候診區：STEMI 延遲辨識使每分鐘心肌持續壞死，門球時間失守。
stages.pitfallEn: If left in the waiting area: STEMI recognition is delayed, myocardium dies by the minute and door-to-balloon targets are lost.

stages.title: 10 分鐘內取得 12 導程心電圖
stages.evidence: 到院第 6 分鐘，心電圖已貼好；技術員問是否等主治醫師在場再做。
stages.evidenceEn: Minute 6 after arrival, leads are on; the technician asks whether to wait for the attending before recording.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即記錄並交由醫師即時判讀
choices.en: Record now; a physician reads it at once

choices.zh: 等主治醫師到場確認後再記錄心電圖
choices.en: Wait for the attending, then record

choices.zh: 先完成抽血與胸片再做心電圖
choices.en: Bloods and chest film first, then ECG

stages.reason: 心電圖是胸痛最早的分流工具，必須在 10 分鐘內取得並由有資格者判讀，不因人員調度延後。
stages.reasonEn: The ECG is the earliest triage tool; it must be acquired within 10 minutes and read by a qualified reader, never delayed for staffing.
stages.pitfall: 若延後：ST 上升型心肌梗塞的再灌注時鐘從到院即開始，延遲判讀直接延長缺血時間。
stages.pitfallEn: If delayed: the reperfusion clock starts at arrival; a late read lengthens total ischaemic time.

stages.title: 生命徵象與持續監視
stages.evidence: 血壓 150/92、心率 98、SpO2 96%；患者仍持續胸痛。
stages.evidenceEn: BP 150/92, HR 98, SpO2 96%; pain is ongoing.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 常規給予高流量氧氣以保護缺血心肌
choices.en: Routine high-flow oxygen to protect myocardium

choices.zh: 監視與去顫器就位，不常規給氧
choices.en: Monitor, defibrillator ready; no routine oxygen

choices.zh: 先送胸部影像檢查再接監視
choices.en: Chest imaging first, monitor afterwards

stages.reason: 持續胸痛的 ACS 患者有心室顫動風險，需連續監視與去顫器就位；氧氣僅在低血氧時給予。
stages.reasonEn: Ongoing ACS pain carries a VF risk, so continuous monitoring with a defibrillator at hand is mandatory; oxygen only for hypoxaemia.
stages.pitfall: 若無監視：首小時心室顫動若未被即時發現，將錯失可逆轉的猝死。
stages.pitfallEn: If unmonitored: first-hour VF can go unseen and a reversible arrest becomes a death.

stages.title: 聚焦病史：性質、時間與危險因子
stages.titleEn: Focused history: character, timing and risk factors
stages.evidence: 疼痛持續 40 分鐘未緩解，運動時加劇；有高血壓、抽菸 30 包年、父親 55 歲心肌梗塞。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain 40 minutes and unrelieved, worse on exertion; hypertension, 30 pack-years, father had MI at 55.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 問是否曾使用 PDE5 抑制劑與抗凝藥
choices.en: Ask about PDE5 inhibitor and anticoagulant use

choices.zh: 危險因子已足夠，直接安排冠狀動脈 CT 檢查
choices.en: Risk factors suffice; order coronary CT

choices.zh: 病史已足夠，不必再追問用藥細節
choices.en: History is enough; skip the medication details

stages.reason: 用藥史決定初始治療安全：近期 PDE5 抑制劑禁用硝酸鹽，抗凝藥影響抗栓與介入規劃。
stages.reasonEn: Medication history decides safe initial treatment: recent PDE5 inhibitors contraindicate nitrates, anticoagulants shape antithrombotic and access plans.
stages.pitfall: 若未問 PDE5 抑制劑：併用硝酸鹽可引起頑固性低血壓與冠狀動脈灌注崩潰。
stages.pitfallEn: If PDE5 use is missed: nitrates can cause refractory hypotension and collapse of coronary perfusion.

stages.title: 判讀心電圖：排除 ST 上升
stages.titleEn: Read the ECG: exclude ST elevation
stages.evidence: 竇性節律 96/分，V4–V6 ST 下移 1 mm，T 波倒置；無 ST 上升，無新 LBBB。
stages.evidenceEn: Sinus 96/min, 1 mm ST depression V4–V6 with T inversion; no ST elevation, no new LBBB.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: ST 下移即應立即啟動導管室 STEMI 流程
choices.en: ST depression: activate the STEMI pathway

choices.zh: NSTE-ACS，加做後壁右側導程並追蹤
choices.en: NSTE-ACS; add posterior/right leads, serial ECGs

choices.zh: 無 ST 上升，可降低檢傷等級並候診
choices.en: No ST elevation; downgrade and wait

stages.reason: ST 下移屬 NSTE-ACS；後壁與右心室導程可揭露被漏掉的 STEMI 等同型，且症狀持續時應每 15–30 分鐘重做。
stages.reasonEn: ST depression means NSTE-ACS; posterior and right-sided leads unmask missed STEMI equivalents, and the ECG is repeated every 15–30 minutes while symptoms persist.
stages.pitfall: 若單次心電圖即下結論：動態變化與後壁梗塞會被遺漏，患者可能在候診區惡化。
stages.pitfallEn: If one ECG is treated as final: dynamic change and posterior infarction are missed and the patient deteriorates unnoticed.

stages.title: 高敏肌鈣蛋白 0/1 小時流程
stages.evidence: 0 小時 hs-cTnT 高於第 99 百分位；1 小時再抽上升明顯。
stages.evidenceEn: 0-h hs-cTnT above the 99th percentile; the 1-hour value rises clearly.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 排入：住院並按 NSTEMI 處置
choices.en: Rule-in: admit and manage as NSTEMI

choices.zh: 仍需等到 6 小時第三次抽血再做決定
choices.en: Wait for a third sample at 6 hours

choices.zh: 單次陽性即診斷第二型心肌梗塞
choices.en: One positive value means type 2 MI

stages.reason: 0/1h 流程以絕對值與變化量排入或排除；明顯上升加上缺血證據符合第一型心肌梗塞，無須等到 6 小時。
stages.reasonEn: The 0/1-h algorithm rules in or out on absolute values and delta; a clear rise with ischaemic evidence meets type 1 MI criteria without waiting 6 hours.
stages.pitfall: 若等待：延後抗栓與侵入性策略，增加再梗塞與心衰竭風險。
stages.pitfallEn: If you wait: antithrombotic therapy and the invasive strategy are delayed, raising reinfarction and heart-failure risk.

stages.title: 鑑別致命性非 ACS 胸痛
stages.evidence: 疼痛撕裂感向背部？否。兩臂血壓差 8 mmHg，無舒張期雜音，胸片縱膈不寬。
stages.evidenceEn: Tearing pain to the back? No. Arm-to-arm BP difference 8 mmHg, no diastolic murmur, mediastinum not widened.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 剝離機率低，依 ACS 流程給抗栓
choices.en: Dissection unlikely; give ACS antithrombotics

choices.zh: 所有胸痛病人都應先做主動脈 CT 檢查
choices.en: Every chest pain needs an aortic CT first

choices.zh: 既非剝離，無需再考慮肺栓塞與氣胸
choices.en: Not dissection, so ignore PE and pneumothorax

stages.reason: 給抗栓前必須排除主動脈剝離、肺栓塞、氣胸與心包填塞的警訊；本例剝離風險指標皆陰性。
stages.reasonEn: Before antithrombotics, red flags for dissection, PE, pneumothorax and tamponade must be screened; here the dissection risk markers are negative.
stages.pitfall: 若未篩檢剝離即抗栓：剝離患者接受抗血小板與抗凝可致大出血與心包填塞。
stages.pitfallEn: If dissection is not screened: antiplatelets and anticoagulants in a dissection cause catastrophic bleeding and tamponade.

stages.title: 計算 HEART 評分
stages.evidence: 病史高度可疑 2、ECG 明顯 ST 下移 2、年齡 58 歲 1、危險因子 ≥3 項 2、肌鈣蛋白明顯升高 2。
stages.evidenceEn: History highly suspicious 2, ECG significant ST depression 2, age 58 = 1, ≥3 risk factors 2, troponin clearly raised 2.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 總分 9 分：高風險，早期侵入性評估
choices.en: Score 9: high risk; early invasive strategy

choices.zh: 總分 5 分：中風險，留觀再評估
choices.en: Score 5: intermediate; observe and repeat

choices.zh: 9 分屬中風險，留觀 3 小時後再驗
choices.en: Score 9 is intermediate; observe, retest at 3 h

stages.reason: HEART 0–3 低、4–6 中、7–10 高風險；明顯 ST 下移在 ECG 項得 2 分；高分應住院並規劃侵入性策略。
stages.reasonEn: HEART 0–3 is low, 4–6 intermediate, 7–10 high risk; significant ST depression scores 2 on the ECG item, and a high score mandates admission with an invasive plan.
stages.pitfall: 若誤算為低分而出院：早期出院的漏診心肌梗塞是急診最常見的致命錯誤之一。
stages.pitfallEn: If miscalculated as low and discharged: a missed MI sent home is among the most lethal ED errors.

stages.title: 初始抗血栓與症狀治療
stages.evidence: 無阿斯匹靈過敏、無活動性出血、未用 PDE5 抑制劑、血壓 150/92。
stages.evidenceEn: No aspirin allergy, no active bleeding, no PDE5 inhibitor, BP 150/92.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 嚼服阿斯匹靈、舌下硝酸鹽並抗凝
choices.en: Chewed aspirin, sublingual nitrate, anticoagulant

choices.zh: 先給靜脈嗎啡止痛，再考慮抗血小板
choices.en: IV morphine first, antiplatelets later

choices.zh: 胸痛持續不緩解，立即給予纖溶劑
choices.en: Ongoing pain: give fibrinolysis now

stages.reason: NSTE-ACS 初始處置為阿斯匹靈、抗凝與症狀控制；纖溶僅用於 STEMI，嗎啡會延遲口服 P2Y12 吸收。
stages.reasonEn: Initial NSTE-ACS care is aspirin, anticoagulation and symptom control; fibrinolysis is for STEMI only and morphine delays oral P2Y12 absorption.
stages.pitfall: 若對 NSTE-ACS 施打纖溶劑：無益處卻增加顱內出血，屬指引明確反對。
stages.pitfallEn: If fibrinolysis is given for NSTE-ACS: no benefit, more intracranial haemorrhage, and the guidelines clearly advise against it.

stages.title: 去向：監視病床與侵入性時機
stages.titleEn: Disposition: monitored bed and invasive timing
stages.evidence: 胸痛已緩解、血流動力學穩定、無惡性心律；GRACE 分數 > 140。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain settled, haemodynamics stable, no malignant arrhythmia; GRACE > 140.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 收心臟監視病床，24 小時內冠狀動脈攝影
choices.en: Monitored cardiac bed; angiography within 24 h

choices.zh: 胸痛已緩解，收一般病房擇期追蹤
choices.en: Pain-free: general ward, elective follow-up

choices.zh: 立即推入導管室如同 STEMI
choices.en: Immediate cath lab as for STEMI

stages.reason: 高風險 NSTE-ACS（GRACE > 140 或 NSTEMI）建議 24 小時內早期侵入性策略；僅極高風險需立即（< 2 小時）。
stages.reasonEn: High-risk NSTE-ACS (GRACE > 140 or NSTEMI) warrants an early invasive strategy within 24 hours; only very-high-risk features need immediate (< 2 h) angiography.
stages.pitfall: 若收一般病房：失去監視，心律不整與再缺血無法及時處理。
stages.pitfallEn: If sent to a general ward: monitoring is lost and arrhythmia or recurrent ischaemia goes unrecognised.

procedures.title: STEMI 判讀與啟動導管室（門球時間）
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：62 歲女性，糖尿病，壓迫性胸痛 2 小時由救護車送達，到院前心電圖顯示下壁 ST 上升。本單元教導時間流程與決策，不含個別藥物劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 62-year-old woman with diabetes, 2 hours of crushing chest pain, arrives by ambulance with a pre-hospital ECG showing inferior ST elevation. Teaches the time-critical pathway; no individual drug doses.

stages.title: 接收到院前心電圖通報
stages.evidence: 救護車傳來心電圖：II、III、aVF ST 上升 2 mm，aVL 對應性下移；預計 8 分鐘到院。
stages.evidenceEn: Ambulance transmits ECG: 2 mm ST elevation in II, III, aVF with reciprocal depression in aVL; ETA 8 minutes.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 到院後再由急診醫師確認心電圖才啟動
choices.en: Activate only after ED physician confirms on arrival

choices.zh: 依院前心電圖預先啟動導管室團隊
choices.en: Pre-activate the cath-lab team on the field ECG

choices.zh: 先聯絡家屬到場完成同意書再啟動
choices.en: Get family in to sign consent before activating

stages.reason: 院前心電圖預先啟動可縮短首次醫療接觸到導線通過時間，是指引建議的系統措施。
stages.reasonEn: Pre-hospital ECG activation shortens first-medical-contact-to-wire time and is a guideline-endorsed system measure.
stages.pitfall: 若等到院確認：每延遲 30 分鐘死亡率上升，院前通報的價值全部流失。
stages.pitfallEn: If activation waits for arrival: every 30-minute delay raises mortality and the pre-hospital alert is wasted.

stages.title: 到院心電圖確認 STEMI 準則
stages.titleEn: Confirm STEMI criteria on the arrival ECG
stages.evidence: 兩個相鄰導程 ST 上升 ≥ 1 mm（II、III、aVF），III > II，伴對應性變化。
stages.evidenceEn: ST elevation ≥ 1 mm in two contiguous leads (II, III, aVF), III > II, with reciprocal change.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 下壁 STEMI，疑右冠狀動脈
choices.en: Inferior STEMI; right coronary suspected

choices.zh: 屬良性的早期再極化變化，先觀察即可
choices.en: Benign early repolarisation; observe

choices.zh: 需等肌鈣蛋白陽性才可正式診斷
choices.en: Troponin must turn positive first

stages.reason: STEMI 由心電圖與症狀即可診斷，不等待生化；III > II 與 aVL 對應下移指向右冠狀動脈。
stages.reasonEn: STEMI is diagnosed from symptoms plus ECG, never delayed for biomarkers; III > II with aVL reciprocal depression points to the RCA.
stages.pitfall: 若等肌鈣蛋白：肌鈣蛋白數小時後才升高，等待等於放棄再灌注時限。
stages.pitfallEn: If you wait for troponin: it rises hours later; waiting abandons the reperfusion window.

stages.title: 一通電話啟動導管室
stages.evidence: 到院第 4 分鐘，心電圖已確認；介入團隊在院外待命，30 分鐘內可到。
stages.evidenceEn: Minute 4, ECG confirmed; the interventional team is on call off-site, 30 minutes away.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即啟動，並同步記錄到院時間
choices.en: Activate now and log the door time

choices.zh: 先完成胸部 X 光排除剝離再啟動
choices.en: Chest X-ray to exclude dissection first

choices.zh: 等心臟科會診評估後再啟動
choices.en: Activate after the cardiology consult

stages.reason: 門球時間目標 ≤ 90 分鐘，首次醫療接觸到導線通過 ≤ 120 分鐘；啟動必須是單一電話、平行進行。
stages.reasonEn: Door-to-balloon target is ≤ 90 minutes and FMC-to-wire ≤ 120 minutes; activation must be a single call run in parallel with everything else.
stages.pitfall: 若等會診或影像：序列式流程每步加 10–20 分鐘，門球時間必然超標。
stages.pitfallEn: If activation waits for consults or imaging: sequential steps add 10–20 minutes each and the target is inevitably missed.

stages.title: 加做右側導程評估右心室梗塞
stages.evidence: V4R 顯示 ST 上升 1 mm；患者血壓 92/60，頸靜脈怒張，肺野清。
stages.evidenceEn: V4R shows 1 mm ST elevation; BP 92/60, JVP raised, lungs clear.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 右心室梗塞：避硝酸鹽，審慎輸液
choices.en: RV infarct: avoid nitrates, cautious fluids

choices.zh: 胸痛持續，先給舌下硝酸鹽緩解
choices.en: Ongoing pain: sublingual nitrate first

choices.zh: 頸靜脈怒張，給利尿劑降低前負荷
choices.en: Raised JVP: diuretic to cut preload

stages.reason: 右心室梗塞依賴前負荷；硝酸鹽與利尿劑會使心輸出量崩潰，應以輸液維持右心充填。
stages.reasonEn: RV infarction is preload-dependent; nitrates and diuretics collapse cardiac output, so filling is maintained with fluids.
stages.pitfall: 若給硝酸鹽：靜脈擴張使右心前負荷驟降，發生嚴重低血壓甚至休克。
stages.pitfallEn: If nitrates are given: venodilation drops RV preload and precipitates profound hypotension or shock.

stages.title: 給予雙重抗血小板與抗凝
stages.titleEn: Give dual antiplatelet therapy and anticoagulation
stages.evidence: 無出血史、無抗凝使用、無中風病史；計畫 primary PCI。
stages.evidenceEn: No bleeding history, not anticoagulated, no prior stroke; primary PCI planned.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 阿斯匹靈加強效 P2Y12，術中抗凝
choices.en: Aspirin plus potent P2Y12; anticoagulate in the lab

choices.zh: 僅給阿斯匹靈，P2Y12 抑制劑等術後再給
choices.en: Aspirin only; P2Y12 inhibitor after the procedure

choices.zh: 以口服抗凝劑取代導管室的靜脈肝素
choices.en: Oral anticoagulant instead of lab heparin

stages.reason: Primary PCI 前給 DAPT，術中以靜脈抗凝（如肝素）依 ACT 調整；口服抗凝不是手術中抗凝。
stages.reasonEn: DAPT precedes primary PCI; intra-procedural anticoagulation (e.g. heparin) is titrated to ACT; oral anticoagulants are not procedural anticoagulation.
stages.pitfall: 若延後 P2Y12：支架植入時血小板未被抑制，急性支架血栓風險上升。
stages.pitfallEn: If the P2Y12 inhibitor is delayed: platelets are uninhibited at stenting and acute stent thrombosis risk rises.

stages.title: 評估 Killip 分級與休克
stages.evidence: 肺底無囉音、無 S3、SpO2 96%、乳酸正常；血壓隨輸液回升至 108/70。
stages.evidenceEn: No crackles, no S3, SpO2 96%, lactate normal; BP rises to 108/70 with fluids.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: Killip I，可依常規路徑進導管室
choices.en: Killip I; proceed on the standard pathway

choices.zh: Killip IV，先放主動脈內氣球幫浦
choices.en: Killip IV; insert an IABP first

choices.zh: 肺水腫，先給非侵襲性正壓通氣
choices.en: Pulmonary oedema; start NIV first

stages.reason: Killip 分級依肺部與灌注表現；本例無心衰竭或休克，不需機械輔助，直接再灌注最有效。
stages.reasonEn: Killip class is assigned from lung and perfusion findings; with no failure or shock, mechanical support is unnecessary and prompt reperfusion matters most.
stages.pitfall: 若錯誤放置 IABP：延後再灌注且增加血管與出血併發症，無存活益處。
stages.pitfallEn: If an IABP is placed unnecessarily: reperfusion is delayed and vascular/bleeding complications rise without survival benefit.

stages.title: 選擇再灌注策略
stages.evidence: 症狀 2 小時，預計到導線通過 70 分鐘；無纖溶禁忌。
stages.evidenceEn: Symptoms 2 hours; anticipated time to wire crossing 70 minutes; no fibrinolysis contraindication.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 可於時限內完成，首選 PCI
choices.en: Achievable in time, so primary PCI

choices.zh: 先給纖溶劑，再轉送導管室
choices.en: Give fibrinolysis first, then transfer

choices.zh: 纖溶與 PCI 同時進行以求保險
choices.en: Lysis and PCI together to be safe

stages.reason: 若 120 分鐘內可完成 PCI，首選 primary PCI；無法達成時才在 10 分鐘內啟動纖溶並於之後轉送。
stages.reasonEn: Primary PCI is preferred whenever achievable within 120 minutes; fibrinolysis within 10 minutes of diagnosis is the fallback when it is not, followed by transfer.
stages.pitfall: 若在可及 PCI 下仍纖溶：增加顱內出血與再梗塞，且導管仍需進行。
stages.pitfallEn: If fibrinolysis is used when PCI is available: intracranial bleeding and reinfarction rise, and catheterisation is still needed.

stages.title: 轉送至導管室與交接
stages.titleEn: Transfer to the lab with handover
stages.evidence: 患者已接監視器、去顫貼片、兩條靜脈路徑；護理交接單尚未填寫。
stages.evidenceEn: Monitor and pads on, two IV lines; nursing handover sheet not yet completed.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 立即移動，口頭交接並記錄給藥時間
choices.en: Move now; verbal handover with drug times

choices.zh: 等護理交接單與書面文件完成再移動
choices.en: Finish the handover sheet and paperwork first

choices.zh: 暫時拔除去顫貼片以方便快速移動
choices.en: Remove the pads briefly to move faster

stages.reason: 轉送不等書面，但口頭交接必須含抗栓藥物與時間、過敏、腎功能與抗凝狀態，去顫貼片全程保留。
stages.reasonEn: Transfer is never held for paperwork, but verbal handover must cover antithrombotics with times, allergies, renal function and anticoagulation; pads stay on throughout.
stages.pitfall: 若拔貼片：轉送途中心室顫動時失去數秒內除顫的能力。
stages.pitfallEn: If pads are removed: VF in the corridor loses the ability to defibrillate within seconds.

stages.title: 導管室：罪犯血管處理原則
stages.evidence: 血管攝影：右冠狀動脈中段完全阻塞，TIMI 0；前降支 60% 狹窄。
stages.evidenceEn: Angiography: mid-RCA total occlusion, TIMI 0; 60% LAD stenosis.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先處理罪犯血管，其餘依穩定度分期
choices.en: Culprit first; others staged by stability

choices.zh: 一次處理所有病灶，不論血流動力學
choices.en: Treat every lesion now regardless of haemodynamics

choices.zh: 只做攝影，隔天再一併介入處理
choices.en: Angiography only; treat everything tomorrow

stages.reason: STEMI 以罪犯血管再灌注為首要；血流動力學穩定的多支病變可於同次或住院期間完成完整血運重建。
stages.reasonEn: STEMI care prioritises culprit reperfusion; in stable multivessel disease, complete revascularisation can follow in the same sitting or during the admission.
stages.pitfall: 若擱置罪犯血管到隔天：缺血持續，心肌挽救量與左心室功能永久損失。
stages.pitfallEn: If the culprit is deferred to tomorrow: ischaemia continues and myocardial salvage is permanently lost.

stages.title: 再灌注後心律監測
stages.evidence: 導線通過後出現加速性心室自主節律 90/分，血壓穩定，30 秒自行終止。
stages.evidenceEn: After wire crossing, accelerated idioventricular rhythm at 90/min, BP stable, self-terminates in 30 seconds.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 再灌注良性心律，觀察即可
choices.en: A benign reperfusion rhythm; observe

choices.zh: 寬 QRS 心律，立即同步電擊
choices.en: Wide QRS rhythm: synchronised shock now

choices.zh: 靜注抗心律不整藥預防復發
choices.en: IV antiarrhythmic to prevent recurrence

stages.reason: 加速性心室自主節律是再灌注的良性標記，血流動力學穩定時不需治療。
stages.reasonEn: Accelerated idioventricular rhythm is a benign marker of reperfusion and needs no treatment when haemodynamics are stable.
stages.pitfall: 若電擊或給藥：對良性節律的治療本身可誘發更惡性心律與低血壓。
stages.pitfallEn: If shocked or drugged: treating a benign rhythm can itself provoke malignant arrhythmia and hypotension.

stages.title: 術後冠心加護與第二級預防啟動
stages.titleEn: Post-PCI CCU care and secondary prevention
stages.evidence: 術後 2 小時，橈動脈止血帶在位，無胸痛；血糖 220 mg/dL。
stages.evidenceEn: 2 hours post-PCI, radial band in place, pain-free; glucose 220 mg/dL.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先他汀控糖；β 阻斷劑/ACEi 待血壓穩
choices.en: Statin and glucose now; BB/ACEi once BP allows

choices.zh: 病情剛穩定，等出院門診時再開始各項預防用藥
choices.en: Just stabilised; start drugs at clinic

choices.zh: 已放支架，僅續用 DAPT 即可
choices.en: Stented, so DAPT alone is enough

stages.reason: 二級預防於住院啟動：DAPT、高強度他汀與控糖先行；右心室梗塞剛需輸液，β 阻斷劑與 ACEi 待血壓穩定再加。
stages.reasonEn: Secondary prevention starts in hospital with DAPT, a high-intensity statin and glucose control; after an RV infarct that needed fluids, beta-blocker and ACEi wait until BP is stable.
stages.pitfall: 若延後至門診：出院後首月是再梗塞與死亡高峰，未啟動治療的患者承擔最大風險。
stages.pitfallEn: If deferred to clinic: the first month after discharge is the peak of reinfarction and death, and untreated patients bear the greatest risk.

stages.title: 辨識機械性併發症警訊
stages.evidence: 術後第 3 天新出現全收縮期雜音與低血壓；心臟超音波顯示心室中隔缺損分流。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 3: new pansystolic murmur with hypotension; echo shows a ventricular septal rupture shunt.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 緊急心臟外科會診與機械輔助評估
choices.en: Emergency cardiac surgery and mechanical support review

choices.zh: 加強利尿劑並觀察血壓變化
choices.en: Increase the diuretic and watch the BP

choices.zh: 立即再做一次導管介入檢查支架通暢
choices.en: Repeat PCI to check the stent

stages.reason: 梗塞後中隔破裂、乳頭肌斷裂與游離壁破裂多發生於第 3–5 天，需立即外科評估，藥物無法根治。
stages.reasonEn: Post-infarct septal rupture, papillary muscle rupture and free-wall rupture cluster around days 3–5 and need immediate surgical assessment; drugs cannot fix them.
stages.pitfall: 若僅用利尿劑：分流持續導致進行性心因性休克，死亡率極高。
stages.pitfallEn: If managed with diuretics alone: the shunt drives progressive cardiogenic shock with very high mortality.

procedures.title: NSTE-ACS 風險分層（GRACE）與抗栓策略
procedures.titleEn: NSTE-ACS risk stratification (GRACE) and antithrombotic strategy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：71 歲男性，慢性腎病第 3 期，休息胸痛反覆兩天，hs-troponin 上升，無 ST 上升。本單元教導分層與時機，不教個別劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 71-year-old man, CKD stage 3, recurrent rest pain for two days, rising hs-troponin, no ST elevation. Teaches stratification and timing, not individual dosing.

stages.title: 確認心電圖無 ST 上升
stages.titleEn: Confirm no ST elevation on ECG
stages.evidence: V5–V6 水平 ST 下移 1.5 mm，aVR 無上升；症狀中與無症狀時心電圖比較有動態變化。
stages.evidenceEn: Horizontal ST depression 1.5 mm in V5–V6, no aVR elevation; dynamic change between symptomatic and pain-free tracings.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 動態 ST 變化屬高風險 NSTE-ACS
choices.en: Dynamic ST change marks high-risk NSTE-ACS

choices.zh: 無 ST 上升即屬低風險，可觀察
choices.en: No ST elevation means low risk; observe

choices.zh: aVR 沒有上升即可完全排除左主幹病變
choices.en: No aVR elevation excludes left main disease

stages.reason: 動態 ST 變化是高風險特徵；aVR 上升伴廣泛下移提示左主幹或三支病變，但缺乏它不能排除。
stages.reasonEn: Dynamic ST change is a high-risk feature; aVR elevation with widespread depression suggests left main or three-vessel disease, but its absence does not exclude it.
stages.pitfall: 若視為低風險：高風險患者未被安排早期侵入性策略，再梗塞與死亡風險上升。
stages.pitfallEn: If labelled low risk: a high-risk patient misses the early invasive strategy and faces higher reinfarction and death.

stages.title: 肌鈣蛋白動態與心肌梗塞類型
stages.evidence: hs-cTnI 0h 150 ng/L，1h 310 ng/L；血紅素正常，無敗血症或心搏過速。
stages.evidenceEn: hs-cTnI 150 ng/L at 0 h, 310 ng/L at 1 h; haemoglobin normal, no sepsis or tachycardia.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 第一型心肌梗塞（斑塊事件）
choices.en: Type 1 MI (plaque event)

choices.zh: 第二型心肌梗塞（供需失衡）
choices.en: Type 2 MI (supply–demand mismatch)

choices.zh: 慢性腎病造成的穩定升高
choices.en: Chronic stable elevation from CKD

stages.reason: 有缺血症狀、動態心電圖與明顯上升下降，且無供需失衡誘因時屬第一型；慢性腎病為平坦非動態升高。
stages.reasonEn: Ischaemic symptoms, dynamic ECG and a clear rise/fall without a mismatch trigger define type 1; CKD gives a flat, non-dynamic elevation.
stages.pitfall: 若誤判為第二型或慢性升高：不給抗栓與血運重建，斑塊事件持續進展。
stages.pitfallEn: If misread as type 2 or chronic: antithrombotics and revascularisation are withheld while the plaque event progresses.

stages.title: 計算 GRACE 評分
stages.evidence: 年齡 71、心率 92、收縮壓 118、肌酸酐 1.8、Killip I、心搏停止否、ST 偏移有、心肌酶升高有。
stages.evidenceEn: Age 71, HR 92, SBP 118, creatinine 1.8, Killip I, no arrest, ST deviation yes, enzyme rise yes.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: GRACE > 140，高風險
choices.en: GRACE over 140: high risk

choices.zh: GRACE < 109，低風險
choices.en: GRACE under 109: low risk

choices.zh: GRACE 不計入腎功能，無法計算
choices.en: GRACE ignores renal function; can't score

stages.reason: GRACE 整合年齡、血流動力學、腎功能、心電圖與生化，> 140 分屬高風險，建議 24 小時內侵入性評估。
stages.reasonEn: GRACE integrates age, haemodynamics, renal function, ECG and biomarkers; > 140 is high risk and supports angiography within 24 hours.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略腎功能等變項而低估：延後導管，死亡率預測失真。
stages.pitfallEn: If variables like renal function are dropped and risk is underestimated: catheterisation is delayed and mortality prediction is wrong.

stages.title: 篩檢極高風險特徵
stages.evidence: 目前胸痛再發且藥物無法緩解，血壓穩定，無惡性心律，無急性心衰竭。
stages.evidenceEn: Refractory recurrent angina despite medical therapy; BP stable, no malignant arrhythmia, no acute heart failure.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 頑固性心絞痛屬極高風險，2 小時內導管
choices.en: Refractory angina: very high risk, cath within 2 h

choices.zh: 血壓穩定，24 小時內導管即可
choices.en: BP is stable; a catheter within 24 h is fine

choices.zh: 再給一次靜脈嗎啡止痛後觀察
choices.en: Another dose of IV morphine and observe

stages.reason: 極高風險特徵包括血流動力學不穩、頑固性心絞痛、致命心律、機械併發症、急性心衰竭與反覆動態 ST 變化，應立即侵入性處理。
stages.reasonEn: Very-high-risk features are haemodynamic instability, refractory angina, life-threatening arrhythmia, mechanical complications, acute heart failure and recurrent dynamic ST change; they mandate an immediate invasive strategy.
stages.pitfall: 若等待 24 小時：持續缺血演變為梗塞擴大或心因性休克。
stages.pitfallEn: If you wait 24 hours: ongoing ischaemia evolves into infarct extension or cardiogenic shock.

stages.title: 評估出血風險
stages.evidence: 慢性腎病第 3 期、年齡 71、血紅素 12.8、無出血史、無抗凝；無近期手術。
stages.evidenceEn: CKD 3, age 71, Hb 12.8, no bleeding history, no anticoagulant, no recent surgery.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 腎功能與年齡增加出血，影響選擇
choices.en: Age and kidneys raise bleeding risk, guiding choices

choices.zh: 出血風險只決定是否進行導管檢查
choices.en: Bleeding risk only decides whether to do the catheter

choices.zh: 沒有出血病史即屬低出血風險
choices.en: No bleeding history means low risk

stages.reason: 出血風險（如 ARC-HBR 準則）與缺血風險一同決定抗栓強度、療程與血管路徑；腎功能是主要因子。
stages.reasonEn: Bleeding risk (e.g. ARC-HBR criteria) is weighed alongside ischaemic risk to set antithrombotic intensity, duration and access route; renal function is a leading factor.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：腎功能不佳者抗凝過量，發生大出血並被迫中斷抗血小板。
stages.pitfallEn: If ignored: anticoagulants accumulate in renal impairment, major bleeding follows and antiplatelets must be stopped.

stages.title: 選擇 P2Y12 抑制劑與給藥時機
stages.titleEn: Choose the P2Y12 inhibitor and its timing
stages.evidence: 預計 24 小時內冠狀動脈攝影；無中風史；不確定是否需繞道手術。
stages.evidenceEn: Angiography within 24 hours; no stroke history; need for bypass surgery unknown.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先給阿斯匹靈，P2Y12 待解剖確認
choices.en: Aspirin now; P2Y12 once anatomy is known

choices.zh: 立即給 prasugrel 前置治療
choices.en: Give routine prasugrel pre-treatment now

choices.zh: 完全不給抗血小板直到手術決定
choices.en: Give no antiplatelet until surgery is decided

stages.reason: 預計早期攝影者不建議常規 P2Y12 前置治療，因可能需繞道；阿斯匹靈則應立即。
stages.reasonEn: Routine P2Y12 pre-treatment is not advised when early angiography is planned because bypass surgery may be needed; aspirin is given immediately.
stages.pitfall: 若前置強效 P2Y12 後需繞道：手術須延後數天或面臨大量出血。
stages.pitfallEn: If a potent P2Y12 inhibitor is pre-loaded and bypass is needed: surgery is delayed days or faces major bleeding.

stages.title: 選擇抗凝劑
stages.evidence: eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m²；計畫 24 小時內攝影。
stages.evidenceEn: eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73 m²; angiography within 24 hours.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 依腎功能選擇調整抗凝，避免換藥
choices.en: Choose and dose by renal function; don't switch

choices.zh: 任何抗凝劑皆可使用，劑量不需調整
choices.en: Any anticoagulant works; no dose change

choices.zh: 同時給兩種抗凝劑以加倍保護
choices.en: Two anticoagulants for double protection

stages.reason: 抗凝劑依腎功能選擇與調整，且避免術中更換製劑（crossover 增加出血）。
stages.reasonEn: The anticoagulant is chosen and adjusted for renal function, and crossover between agents is avoided because it increases bleeding.
stages.pitfall: 若不調整：低分子量肝素在腎功能不佳時蓄積，出血率顯著增加。
stages.pitfallEn: If unadjusted: low-molecular-weight heparin accumulates in renal impairment and bleeding rises sharply.

stages.title: 決定侵入性時機
stages.evidence: 胸痛已被藥物控制，GRACE > 140，肌鈣蛋白陽性，無極高風險特徵。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain controlled, GRACE > 140, troponin positive, no very-high-risk features.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 24 小時內早期侵入性策略
choices.en: Early invasive strategy within 24 h

choices.zh: 72 小時內導管即已足夠
choices.en: Angiography within 72 h is enough

choices.zh: 先做非侵入性負荷檢查再決定
choices.en: Non-invasive stress test first, then decide

stages.reason: 高風險 NSTE-ACS（NSTEMI 或 GRACE > 140）建議 24 小時內侵入性策略；低風險者才考慮選擇性或非侵入性評估。
stages.reasonEn: High-risk NSTE-ACS (NSTEMI or GRACE > 140) warrants an invasive strategy within 24 hours; non-invasive testing is for low-risk patients.
stages.pitfall: 若做負荷檢查：對已確診 NSTEMI 者誘發缺血，且延後必要的血運重建。
stages.pitfallEn: If a stress test is done: it provokes ischaemia in a confirmed NSTEMI and delays needed revascularisation.

stages.title: 顯影劑腎病變預防
stages.evidence: eGFR 38，服用 metformin；攝影預計明早。
stages.evidenceEn: eGFR 38, on metformin; angiography tomorrow morning.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 等張輸液、少用顯影劑、停 metformin
choices.en: Isotonic fluids, minimal contrast, hold metformin

choices.zh: 術後給予大劑量利尿劑促進顯影劑排出
choices.en: High-dose diuretic afterwards to flush contrast

choices.zh: eGFR 38 太低，取消導管檢查
choices.en: eGFR 38 is too low; cancel the angiogram

stages.reason: 高風險患者預防為等張輸液、最少顯影劑與避免腎毒性藥物；腎功能不佳不應剝奪高風險 ACS 的血運重建。
stages.reasonEn: Prevention in at-risk patients is isotonic hydration, minimal contrast and avoiding nephrotoxins; renal impairment should not deny high-risk ACS revascularisation.
stages.pitfall: 若給利尿劑：容積不足加重腎損傷；若取消導管：死於缺血的風險高於腎病變。
stages.pitfallEn: If diuretics are given: volume depletion worsens kidney injury; if catheterisation is cancelled: ischaemic death outweighs the renal risk.

stages.title: 出院前整合與 DAPT 療程
stages.evidence: 已置放藥物塗層支架；出血風險中度；LDL 130 mg/dL；仍抽菸。
stages.evidenceEn: Drug-eluting stent placed; moderate bleeding risk; LDL 130 mg/dL; still smoking.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: DAPT 預設 12 個月、高強度他汀、戒菸
choices.en: Default 12-month DAPT, high-intensity statin, quit smoking

choices.zh: DAPT 只需 1 個月，之後只用阿斯匹靈即可
choices.en: One month of DAPT, then aspirin alone

choices.zh: 他汀等三個月後依血脂再決定是否用
choices.en: Decide on a statin from lipids at three months

stages.reason: ACS 後預設 DAPT 12 個月，高出血風險可縮短；他汀應於住院期間以高強度啟動，4–6 週追蹤。
stages.reasonEn: After ACS the default is 12 months of DAPT, shortened for high bleeding risk; a high-intensity statin starts in hospital with lipids rechecked at 4–6 weeks.
stages.pitfall: 若 DAPT 過早停止：支架血栓風險在前數月最高，可致猝死。
stages.pitfallEn: If DAPT stops too early: stent thrombosis risk peaks in the first months and can be fatal.

procedures.title: 冠狀動脈攝影準備與橈動脈穿刺流程
procedures.titleEn: Coronary angiography preparation and radial access
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：66 歲女性，穩定心絞痛，CT 冠狀動脈攝影顯示前降支中度狹窄，安排侵入性攝影。本單元教導流程與安全核對，不含穿刺深度與藥物劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 66-year-old woman, stable angina, CT angiography shows a moderate LAD lesion; invasive angiography is scheduled. Teaches workflow and safety checks; no puncture depths or drug doses.

stages.title: 確認適應症與知情同意
stages.evidence: CT 顯示中度狹窄且症狀限制生活；患者詢問風險。
stages.evidenceEn: CT shows a moderate lesion with lifestyle-limiting symptoms; the patient asks about risks.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 說明中風、血管、顯影劑與輻射風險
choices.en: Explain stroke, vascular, contrast and radiation risks

choices.zh: 風險極低，直接簽名即可不必逐項說明
choices.en: Risks are tiny; just sign, no itemising

choices.zh: 由護理人員代為說明並簽署即可
choices.en: A nurse can explain and take the signature

stages.reason: 侵入性攝影同意需涵蓋主要併發症與替代方案；由執行醫師說明是標準。
stages.reasonEn: Consent for invasive angiography covers major complications and alternatives and is taken by the performing physician.
stages.pitfall: 若未充分告知：發生併發症時患者無法理解，且構成法律責任。
stages.pitfallEn: If consent is inadequate: complications are not understood by the patient and liability follows.

stages.title: 核對腎功能、過敏與用藥
stages.titleEn: Check renal function, allergy and medications
stages.evidence: eGFR 55；曾對顯影劑出現蕁麻疹；服用 metformin 與 warfarin（INR 2.4）。
stages.evidenceEn: eGFR 55; previous contrast urticaria; takes metformin and warfarin (INR 2.4).
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 過敏前置處理、停 metformin、規劃路徑
choices.en: Allergy premedication, hold metformin, plan access

choices.zh: 蕁麻疹屬輕微過敏，不需前置處理
choices.en: Urticaria is mild; no premedication

choices.zh: INR 2.4 過高，必須取消手術
choices.en: INR 2.4 is too high; cancel the case

stages.reason: 顯影劑過敏史需前置處理與藥物備妥；橈動脈路徑在治療性 INR 下可接受，股動脈則需較多考量。
stages.reasonEn: A contrast allergy history needs premedication and rescue drugs ready; radial access is acceptable at a therapeutic INR, whereas femoral access needs more caution.
stages.pitfall: 若未前置處理：再次暴露可引發過敏性休克；若未暫停 metformin 且腎損傷：乳酸中毒風險。
stages.pitfallEn: If premedication is skipped: re-exposure can cause anaphylaxis; if metformin continues through kidney injury: lactic acidosis risk.

stages.title: 評估橈動脈與側枝循環
stages.titleEn: Assess the radial artery and collateral supply
stages.evidence: 右橈動脈觸診良好；脈搏血氧波形在壓迫橈動脈後仍存在。
stages.evidenceEn: Right radial pulse good; pulse-oximetry waveform persists with radial compression.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 側枝良好，選擇右橈動脈
choices.en: Good collaterals; choose the right radial

choices.zh: 改用股動脈較安全可靠
choices.en: Femoral is safer and more reliable

choices.zh: 橈動脈觸診良好，不需評估側枝
choices.en: Good radial pulse; no collateral check needed

stages.reason: 橈動脈路徑出血與血管併發症較少，為首選；側枝評估（Barbeau/Allen 概念）與超音波可降低風險。
stages.reasonEn: Radial access has fewer bleeding and vascular complications and is first choice; collateral assessment (Barbeau/Allen concept) and ultrasound reduce risk.
stages.pitfall: 若在無側枝下穿刺：橈動脈阻塞可造成手部缺血。
stages.pitfallEn: If punctured without collaterals: radial occlusion can cause hand ischaemia.

stages.title: 無菌準備、鋪單與團隊暫停
stages.titleEn: Sterile prep, draping and team pause
stages.evidence: 手腕與鼠蹊皆已消毒鋪單；團隊確認身分、過敏、抗凝與設備。
stages.evidenceEn: Wrist and groin prepped and draped; team confirms identity, allergy, anticoagulation and equipment.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 完成暫停核對後開始
choices.en: Complete the time-out, then begin the case

choices.zh: 時間緊迫時可省略團隊暫停
choices.en: Skip the team pause when pressed for time

choices.zh: 只消毒手腕，鼠蹊不必準備
choices.en: Prep the wrist only, not the groin

stages.reason: 導管室暫停核對與雙路徑準備（鼠蹊備用）是標準；橈動脈失敗時可立即轉換。
stages.reasonEn: A cath-lab pause and dual-site prep (groin as backup) are standard so that failed radial access converts immediately.
stages.pitfall: 若省略：身分或過敏錯誤無人攔截；若未備鼠蹊：轉換路徑時打破無菌。
stages.pitfallEn: If skipped: identity or allergy errors go uncaught; if the groin is not prepped: switching access breaks sterility.

stages.title: 超音波導引局部麻醉與穿刺
stages.evidence: 超音波顯示橈動脈直徑 2.4 mm，無痙攣；患者緊張。
stages.evidenceEn: Ultrasound: radial artery 2.4 mm, no spasm; the patient is anxious.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 充分局麻與鎮靜，超音波導引單壁穿刺
choices.en: Ample local, light sedation, ultrasound-guided puncture

choices.zh: 憑觸診盲穿，多次嘗試直到成功
choices.en: Blind palpation attempts until success

choices.zh: 不打局麻以免藥物誘發血管痙攣
choices.en: Skip local so it doesn't trigger spasm

stages.reason: 超音波導引提高首次成功率並減少血腫；疼痛與焦慮誘發痙攣，故充分麻醉與鎮靜。
stages.reasonEn: Ultrasound guidance raises first-pass success and reduces haematoma; pain and anxiety provoke spasm, so anaesthesia and sedation are generous.
stages.pitfall: 若反覆盲穿：痙攣與血腫使路徑失敗，被迫改股動脈。
stages.pitfallEn: If repeatedly punctured blind: spasm and haematoma lose the access and force a femoral switch.

stages.title: 置入鞘管與橈動脈藥物
stages.titleEn: Insert the sheath and give the radial cocktail
stages.evidence: 導線順利進入，鞘管就位，回血良好。
stages.evidenceEn: Wire advances freely, sheath in place, good backflow.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 經鞘給抗痙攣與抗凝，防橈動脈阻塞
choices.en: Antispasmodic and anticoagulant via the sheath

choices.zh: 等導管到達主動脈根部後才給予抗凝
choices.en: Anticoagulate once the catheter reaches the aortic root

choices.zh: 單純診斷性攝影不需要給抗凝
choices.en: Diagnostic angiography needs no anticoagulation

stages.reason: 鞘管置入後即給抗痙攣劑與全身抗凝，是降低橈動脈阻塞的關鍵措施。
stages.reasonEn: Antispasmodic plus systemic anticoagulation immediately after sheath insertion is the key measure against radial artery occlusion.
stages.pitfall: 若不抗凝：橈動脈阻塞率顯著上升，影響日後路徑與透析廔管。
stages.pitfallEn: If anticoagulation is omitted: radial occlusion rises markedly, costing future access and fistula options.

stages.title: 導線前進與導管到達主動脈根部
stages.titleEn: Advance wire and catheter to the aortic root
stages.evidence: 導線於前臂近端遇阻力；透視顯示導線進入側枝。
stages.evidenceEn: Resistance at the proximal forearm; fluoroscopy shows the wire in a side branch.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 退回導線，透視下重導並打顯影劑
choices.en: Withdraw, redirect under fluoroscopy, inject contrast

choices.zh: 稍加用力推進以通過阻力
choices.en: Push a little harder past the resistance

choices.zh: 遇阻力即直接改走股動脈
choices.en: Switch straight to femoral at any resistance

stages.reason: 阻力代表側枝、環狀或痙攣；強推會穿孔，應以透視與顯影確認後導向。
stages.reasonEn: Resistance means a side branch, a loop or spasm; forcing causes perforation, so confirm with fluoroscopy and contrast before redirecting.
stages.pitfall: 若強推：前臂動脈穿孔造成血腫甚至腔室症候群。
stages.pitfallEn: If forced: forearm artery perforation causes haematoma or compartment syndrome.

stages.title: 導管卡入與壓力波形
stages.evidence: 導管進入左冠狀動脈口後壓力波形出現下陷（damping）。
stages.evidenceEn: On engaging the left coronary ostium the pressure trace damps.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 退出導管，檢視開口病變或導管深插
choices.en: Disengage; suspect ostial disease or deep seating

choices.zh: 立即大量注射顯影劑看清楚
choices.en: Inject a big contrast bolus to see clearly

choices.zh: 壓力波形變化不重要，繼續注射攝影
choices.en: The trace doesn't matter; keep injecting

stages.reason: 壓力下陷代表導管阻塞開口或深插；此時注射顯影劑會造成剝離或缺血。
stages.reasonEn: A damped trace means the catheter occludes the ostium or is deeply seated; injecting now risks dissection and ischaemia.
stages.pitfall: 若注射：左主幹剝離是導管室最致命的併發症之一。
stages.pitfallEn: If injected: left main dissection is among the most lethal lab complications.

stages.title: 標準投照與血管命名
stages.evidence: RAO 尾位、LAO 顱位、蜘蛛位（LAO 尾位）已取得；前降支近段狹窄約 70%。
stages.evidenceEn: RAO caudal, LAO cranial and spider (LAO caudal) views obtained; ~70% proximal LAD stenosis.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 多角度確認並記錄 TIMI 與長度
choices.en: Confirm in several views; report TIMI and length

choices.zh: 單一最佳角度即足以決定治療
choices.en: One best view is enough to decide treatment

choices.zh: 報告只需記錄狹窄百分比即可
choices.en: Report only the percentage stenosis

stages.reason: 狹窄需正交投照避免縮短效應；報告含血管段、TIMI 血流、鈣化與分支。
stages.reasonEn: Stenosis needs orthogonal views to avoid foreshortening; the report covers segment, TIMI flow, calcification and branches.
stages.pitfall: 若單一角度：偏心病灶被低估或高估，造成錯誤治療決策。
stages.pitfallEn: If a single view is used: eccentric lesions are mis-graded and treatment decisions go wrong.

stages.title: 拔鞘與專利止血（patent haemostasis）
stages.evidence: 手術結束，止血帶充氣後脈搏血氧波形消失。
stages.evidenceEn: Procedure complete; after band inflation the oximetry waveform disappears.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 逐步放氣至波形回復又無出血
choices.en: Deflate stepwise until the trace returns, dry

choices.zh: 保持完全壓迫 4 小時以防出血
choices.en: Full compression for 4 hours against bleeding

choices.zh: 波形消失即立即完全放氣
choices.en: Waveform lost, so deflate fully at once

stages.reason: 專利止血以維持血流通過橈動脈為目標，是降低橈動脈阻塞的證據方法。
stages.reasonEn: Patent haemostasis keeps flow through the radial artery during compression and is the evidence-based way to cut radial occlusion.
stages.pitfall: 若完全壓迫數小時：橈動脈血栓阻塞；若立即放氣：穿刺處出血血腫。
stages.pitfallEn: If fully compressed for hours: radial thrombosis; if released at once: puncture-site bleeding and haematoma.

stages.title: 術後觀察與出院指示
stages.evidence: 止血帶移除後手部溫暖，無血腫；患者問何時可出院。
stages.evidenceEn: Band removed; hand warm, no haematoma; the patient asks about going home.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 觀察數小時，確認血管、腎與神經後出院
choices.en: Observe hours; check access, kidneys, neurology, then discharge

choices.zh: 手部溫暖無血腫，立即出院
choices.en: Warm hand, no haematoma: discharge now

choices.zh: 常規住院三天以防遲發併發症
choices.en: Admit three days for late complications

stages.reason: 診斷性橈動脈攝影可當日出院，但需確認穿刺處、無神經學事件與腎功能計畫。
stages.reasonEn: Diagnostic radial angiography allows same-day discharge once the access site, neurological status and a renal follow-up plan are confirmed.
stages.pitfall: 若立即出院：延遲出血或顯影劑反應在家中發生而無人處理。
stages.pitfallEn: If discharged at once: late bleeding or contrast reactions happen at home unattended.

procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：59 歲男性，NSTEMI，前降支近段 85% 狹窄伴中度鈣化，橈動脈路徑。本單元教導步驟順序與判斷，不含氣球壓力與藥物劑量等可供自行操作的參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 59-year-old man, NSTEMI, 85% proximal LAD lesion with moderate calcification, radial access. Teaches sequence and judgement; no balloon pressures or drug doses that would enable unsupervised practice.

procedures.title: FFR、IVUS 與 OCT 的判讀與應用
procedures.titleEn: FFR, IVUS and OCT: interpretation and use
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：63 歲男性，穩定心絞痛，迴旋支中段 60% 狹窄，攝影難以判定意義。本單元教導生理與影像工具的選擇與判讀，不含設備操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 63-year-old man, stable angina, 60% mid-circumflex lesion of uncertain significance on angiography. Teaches choosing and reading physiology and imaging tools; no device operating parameters.

procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 67-year-old man, anterior STEMI 6 hours from onset, BP 82/55, cold extremities, lactate 4.5. Teaches staging, assessment and support-device concepts; no infusion doses or cannulation parameters.

procedures.title: 急性心衰竭處置
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：74 歲女性，缺血性心肌病變 LVEF 30%，三天體重增加 3 公斤、端坐呼吸，血壓 165/95。本單元教導評估與處置順序，不含利尿劑或血管擴張劑劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 74-year-old woman, ischaemic cardiomyopathy with LVEF 30%, 3 kg weight gain over three days, orthopnoea, BP 165/95. Teaches assessment and treatment order; no diuretic or vasodilator doses.

procedures.title: 慢性 HFrEF 四大支柱與滴定
procedures.titleEn: Chronic HFrEF: the four pillars and titration
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲男性，擴張性心肌病變 LVEF 28%，NYHA II，血壓 118/74，eGFR 62，鉀 4.4。本單元教導啟動順序、監測與滴定原則，不含個別劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 61-year-old man, dilated cardiomyopathy with LVEF 28%, NYHA II, BP 118/74, eGFR 62, K 4.4. Teaches initiation order, monitoring and titration principles; no individual doses.

procedures.title: HFpEF 診斷與管理
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：72 歲女性，高血壓、肥胖、心房顫動，勞力性呼吸困難，LVEF 60%。本單元教導診斷評分、排除擬似疾病與治療原則。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 72-year-old woman, hypertension, obesity and atrial fibrillation, exertional dyspnoea, LVEF 60%. Teaches diagnostic scoring, excluding mimics and treatment principles.

procedures.title: 右心導管與血流動力學判讀
procedures.titleEn: Right heart catheterisation and haemodynamic interpretation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲女性，硬皮症，勞力性呼吸困難，超音波估計肺動脈壓升高，安排右心導管。本單元教導流程與判讀，不含插管深度與藥物劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 55-year-old woman with systemic sclerosis, exertional dyspnoea, echo-estimated raised pulmonary pressure; right heart catheterisation scheduled. Teaches workflow and interpretation; no insertion depths or drug doses.

procedures.title: 心房顫動急診：速率與節律控制、抗凝決策
procedures.titleEn: Atrial fibrillation in the ED: rate versus rhythm and anticoagulation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲男性，高血壓與糖尿病，心悸 6 小時，心率 142 不規則，血壓 128/80。本單元教導決策順序，不含藥物劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 68-year-old man, hypertension and diabetes, palpitations for 6 hours, irregular rate 142, BP 128/80. Teaches decision order; no drug doses.

procedures.title: 電氣整流流程
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：59 歲女性，持續性心房顫動 3 個月，已 DOAC 抗凝 5 週且無漏服，安排擇期電擊整流。本單元教導流程與安全檢查，不含鎮靜劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 59-year-old woman, persistent AF for 3 months, on an uninterrupted DOAC for 5 weeks, scheduled for elective cardioversion. Teaches workflow and safety checks; no sedation doses.

procedures.title: 心導管電燒：肺靜脈隔離
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：54 歲男性，陣發性心房顫動，兩種抗心律不整藥無效，LA 42 mm，無結構性心臟病。本單元教導流程與併發症辨識，不含導管操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 54-year-old man, paroxysmal AF refractory to two antiarrhythmics, LA 42 mm, no structural heart disease. Teaches workflow and complication recognition; no catheter operating parameters.

procedures.title: 室上性心搏過速急性處置
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲女性，突發心悸 1 小時，規則窄 QRS 180/分，血壓 110/70，無結構性心臟病。本單元教導流程與安全，不含藥物劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old woman, sudden palpitations for 1 hour, regular narrow-QRS 180/min, BP 110/70, no structural heart disease. Teaches sequence and safety; no drug doses.

procedures.title: 心室頻脈處置與 ICD 決策
procedures.titleEn: Ventricular tachycardia management and ICD decisions
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：64 歲男性，舊前壁心肌梗塞 LVEF 32%，心悸頭暈，寬 QRS 規則心搏過速 170/分，血壓 95/60。本單元教導判讀、處置與裝置決策，不含劑量。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 64-year-old man, old anterior MI with LVEF 32%, palpitations and dizziness, regular wide-QRS tachycardia 170/min, BP 95/60. Teaches interpretation, treatment and device decisions; no doses.
